title: Compress the selected native scalar graph by 116 ADDs (no new K)
body:
The selected PR4470 scalar word contains repeated ADDs that combine across exactly commuting instructions and noncommuting three-gate triangles with shorter exact replacements. Rebuilding the actual native program removes **116 scalar macros and 914 real primitive allowance units per invocation in each orientation**. All 632 persistent inputs remain arbitrary.

**No higher K is claimed.** The complete Gaussian paid profile, 408 productive helper boundaries and main endpoints are unchanged, so the complete recursive moment is identical for every exponent. This is a local circuit saving and a bounded result on PR4470's changed-scalar-order question, not the requested bottleneck breakthrough or a global scalar-circuit optimum.

Only `research/scalar-trace-compression/` changes. The package reconstructs both words, checks every common frame and paid rank with two retained exact native interpreters, retains free noncommuting warp words and owned-center return, and confirms that no new Gaussian edge needs a phase recipe. Exact prefix bounds remain 457 forward and 169 backward.
